summary: Concise stdlib-only generator producing player.png (16x96 vertical frame stack), floor.png (16x16), preview.png (four 8x scaled directional views plus an 8x4 tiled floor with two standing figures placed by the exact foot-anchor formula), and verification.json with real checks and SHA-256 hashes. Validations were simplified to size, exact palette, alpha, anchor nontransparent and 4-connected to body, tile opacity, sprite-foot==tile-foot equality and bounds; left/right mirror equality is not asserted. PNG bytes are encoded twice and compared before writing for reproducibility. README states truthfully that matrices are original Flash-style, exploratory, not author-approved and not gameplay-verified.
method: single direct Flash request without tools; files authored by Flash
